description: KB retrieval gold eval set (kb-direction.md §4). Queries marked -real are verbatim user questions from the 2026-08-22 production snapshot; -kw are keyword-style probes from the #49 validation notes. selector SQL returns one or more ideal-answer doc_ids from {collection}_docs; every returned id counts as a hit. Selectors match on source_id/title/content patterns (not doc_id) so the set survives re-ingestion.

probes.label: real01 八重神子命座
probes.query: 八重神子的命座效果是什么？查一下？
probes.selector: SELECT doc_id FROM Teyvat_docs WHERE source_id LIKE '%八重神子%' AND title LIKE '命之座%' AND status='active' AND length(content)>20
